question: ______ clicking on mouse selects the entire paragraph by default, while working with text document in MS Word.
solution:
The correct answer is __**triple**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If you want to **select the entire paragraph** in MS Word then** move the pointer to the left of the text and triple-click**. 
 
• You can also select the **paragraph **but **placing your cursor at the start of the paragraph and press the control shift and down arrow**. 
 
• If you want to **move the cursor off by one paragraph **you must **press the Alt + up Arrow key**. 
 
• If you **want to move the cursor down by one paragraph** then you need to **press the alt + down arrow key**. 
 
• if you want to **move the cursor left by one word** you need to **press Alt + left Arrow key and Alt + right Arrow key for moving the cursor right by one word. **
 
• **Clicking **on a **particular text **you will **select the entire word in MS Word**. 
 
• If you want to **select a particular line **in MS Word then **move your cursor to the left and click when an arrow appears**.
